Principal component analysis of the samples

Source: R/plot_mds.R
compute_pca.Rd

Internal function that computes the principal component analysis (prcomp) of the samples on the log2 normalized counts (log_normalized_counts).

Usage

compute_pca(screenR_Object)

Arguments

screenR_Object

The ScreenR object obtained using create_screenr_object.

Value

A prcomp object, with one row for each sample in x.
